title: syngramma marginata

It is a popular ornamental plant due to its striking, delicate fronds and unique growth habit. The plant has been found to have various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which have been associated with reducing stress, improving cardiovascular health, and boosting the immune system. The bioactive constituents of Syngramma marginata include flavonoids, saponins, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and hepatoprotective effects.
